newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraq still negotiating U.S. wheat import tender.
newsitem.headline: Iraq still negotiating U.S. wheat import tender.

text.p: Iraq is still negotiating the purchase of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under a U.N.-monitored oil-for-food deal, European grain exporters said on Thursday.
But they did not know when Iraq would make a decision on the tender, adding price negotiations had been going on for almost a week.
"They are still hesitant," one trader said.
On Monday exporters said the lowest offers received by Iraq stood at around $199-$208 per tonne, cost and freight, for delivery to Jordan's port of Aqaba.
The wheat is for May 15-June 15 shipment.
